description: Temporary endpoint containment. Blocks array-form Jolokia network-connector operations in the first item.
affected_versions: Apache Software Foundation Apache ActiveMQ Broker: 0 to <5.19.4, 6.0.0 to <6.2.3; Apache Software Foundation Apache ActiveMQ All: 0 to <5.19.4, 6.0.0 to <6.2.3; Apache Software Foundation Apache ActiveMQ: 0 to <5.19.4, 6.0.0 to <6.2.3; verify complete affected/fixed ranges and deployment prerequisites in the linked CNA/vendor records.
coverage: Blocks array-form Jolokia network-connector operations in the first item.
limitations: Object-form requests and later array entries are not inspected. Only the declared request facts and bounded native matcher are covered. No vulnerable-deployment reproduction was performed. Direct-origin access, alternate routes/encodings and uninspectable facts remain outside this rule. Apply vendor fixes; this is not complete CVE protection.
false_positive_risk: Legitimate connector administration in that array position is denied.
